newsitem.title: UK: Cigna to push in marine and air insurance.
newsitem.headline: Cigna to push in marine and air insurance.

text.p: CIGNA Property & Casualty has formed INAMAR Insurance Underwriting Agency, Inc. (INAMAR), a new company that will enable CIGNA P&C to market its expertise in ocean marine, aerospace and recreational marine insurance, according to a company statement.

Roy Salley, senior vice president of CIGNA Marine/Aerospace, and Robert Chapman, senior vice president of CIGNA Recreational Marine, have been named executive vice presidents of INAMAR responsible for the facility's day-to-day operations, which will remain in CIGNA P&C's Specialty Insurance Services organization.

"CIGNA P&C boasts a strong reputation in these specialty lines of business," said Roy Salley. "We're one of the top three insurers in both the marine cargo and aerospace lines of business and we're the top writer in the yacht and mega-yacht insurance market."
"With the creation of INAMAR, others in the market now have the opportunity to tap into a pool of expertise CIGNA P&C has been developing for more than 200 years," he said.
"The launch of INAMAR further enhances our ability to respond quickly to the ever-changing demands of the marketplace," added Chapman.

"We now have greater flexibility to develop innovative business alliances and provide others with customized access to our unique portfolio of products and services including our underwriting, claim adjusting, loss control, recovery and training expertise," he said.
